subject: Distinguish between single- and double-click on Leaflet map within Shiny app

messages.author: e9320c15f83db75f
messages.subject: Distinguish between single- and double-click on Leaflet map within Shiny app
parts:
I'm building a Shiny app that incorporates a Leaflet map. The user can move a circle around the map by clicking, which sets the new centre for the circle. However, I only want a single-click event to trigger the circle to move, double-click should zoom but not trigger the circle to move. Thus far I've been unable to find a way to make this distinction between the two event types in leaflet/shiny.

App is live here: https://mstrimas.shinyapps.io/shiny-birds
Code is on GitHub: https://github.com/mstrimas/shiny-birds

And this is the code from server.R that catches the clicks. It updates an numericInput, which in turn triggers the circle to move.  

  observe({
    new_lat <- round(as.numeric(input$birdMap_click$lat) , 3)
    new_lng <- round(as.numeric(input$birdMap_click$lng) , 3)
    updateNumericInput(session, 'latInput', value = new_lat)
    updateNumericInput(session, 'lngInput', value = new_lng)
  })

Thanks!

messages.author: dc3c7e88d9ea3297
messages.subject: Re: Distinguish between single- and double-click on Leaflet map within Shiny app
parts:
My recommendation is just include a UI element that optionally locks the circle or a pop-up asking the user if they intent to move it (which will certainly get them using mouse scrolling for zooming).

Other than that I think you'd have to edit this to something like this. Interesting question, I wonder if this should be an option in rstudio-leaflet, but I haven't seen our users double clicking to zoom.

Chris
